name: 33 mercenaries; prices approved; new cards never enter loot

No recovery without skill; learned skill heals once per round and caps HP
Every rank / region / level / area hiring boundary
All eligible cards draw once before discard recycle, including epic and legendary
Old save migration adds 15 cards exactly once and preserves held mercenaries
Porter capacity +2; dismissal safely moves excess into pending items
Novice first-hit protection only; mist -1 on all enemy attacks
Sergeant +2 only next ordinary attack, not class ability; cannot reuse
Herbalist D6 heal and poison resistance on 5,6 remain independent
Trap seeker D4, bastion D12, oath guardian 2D8 mitigation
Surgeon heals and cleanses bleeding; light healer and oath guardian allow chosen cleanse
Life keeper 2D8 + defense until next enemy attack
Orc arcanist uses the damage D6 for stun, no second effect roll
Chronicler rerolls ordinary and ability attacks with advantage and enemy disadvantage
Chronicler can reroll escape D20; advantage has no natural 1/20
